mask_rule: Polygon intersect original DAVIS union, used only to construct diagnostic intervention outside the model. No mask supplied to inference.
target: Median original VDA q in prior frame0 neck-core ROI [655,223,20,26]; diagnostic reference, not depth truth.

interventions.head_to_neck: Only frame0 head polygon: replace q with original neck median rounded to uint8; preserve original filename focus.
interventions.translated_water_delta: Translate identical head support100 display pixels right; apply identical signed q deltas, clip to0–255 and report clipping; original focus fixed. This control matches pixels/delta, not baseline defocus or semantic context.
interventions.focus_to_head: Only frame0 filename focus is set to prior head-core median q/255, rounded5 decimals. Original disparity stays unchanged; this is an independent focus sensitivity control.

metrics: Paired output change MAE in RGB8 units and input-relative gradient energy/Laplacian energy/residual on fixed ROIs; these diagnose response, not perceptual quality or bokeh accuracy.
limits: One exploration source and one intervened frame; no cross-source or temporal-quality claim
No independent metric depth or paired bokeh GT
New visual quality verdicts remain for user
